# `/suggested-entitlement-description-assignments` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /suggested-entitlement-description-assignments/v1

`submitSedAssignmentV1` — Submit sed assignment request

Submit Assignment Request. Request body has an assignee, and list of SED Ids that are assigned to that assignee API responses with batchId that groups all approval requests together

- Scopes: idn:sed:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Body (application/json-patch+json): sedassignment
- Returns 202: sedassignmentresponse
